raw_response:
I am 73, and I have farmed a long time, so I will keep this year simple, familiar, and within my labor strength. I only have 4.1 mu, and some people in my family work off-farm, so I will not spread myself too thin on crops that need too much watching. Cotton is still the crop I know best and the one I trust most for cash, so I will keep the biggest share in cotton. I will keep some wheat and maize because grain gives me stability and fits our usual farming rhythm in Hebei. I will plant only a small area of stevia, because it can bring cash, but I do not want too much of a crop that needs careful management. Since I have well irrigation, I will use water to protect yield when the weather turns dry, but I still will not push fertilizer too hard because I want steady output, not extra cost and risk. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps me most, and I will choose tillage methods that are practical for my small farm and my age.
